Verified byte equality: 1,412,835 bytes; 1942 × 809 pixels; SHA256 `fed8d8d6bd4e6e9bf432f3d3f3d1b6f1360651b70caedf135b548365c17f84f9`. Round 03: 1 tool call; thread total: 5.

Visual checks:

1. PASS — four named orthographic views, shared baseline, three-quarter view and black silhouette retained. Scale assessed visually, not measured.
2. PASS — 1.8 m figure, LENGTH 18 m, BUBBLE 2.6 m and five part callouts present.
3. PASS — low head, steep climb and high fat back retained. New domes locally round and extend the flank/rear contour.
4. PASS — cream cockpit pillars, forward sockets, magenta thrusters including underside sockets, four recessed rear nozzles, teal modules, red hatch and nine-entry legend retained. Hull construction follows Round 03's replacement instruction.
5. PASS — no decorative numbers, insignia, flames, exhaust, scene or cast shadows.
8. PASS — three broad yellow lobes read in the side/three-quarter views, with long seams and a sweeping orange spine replacing the small slabs.
9. PASS — broad overlapping lens forms and a thin lower rim wrapping the nose are visible.
10. PASS — yellow dome forms intersect the rear/flanks, visible in side, top and three-quarter views.
11. PASS — BUBBLE 2.6 m remains across the front-view bubble.

Prompt sent, verbatim:

How Image 2's hull is actually built (study it): a FEW BIG forms that INTERSECT each other, not many small stacked pieces —
- the main body is one long, broad, gently domed mass whose top slopes down in a single long sweep to a rounded, flattened nose;
- long seams run lengthwise along it, dividing it into three or four big lobes rather than many small plates;
- big hemisphere-like bulges (the striped domes at the left of Image 2) push out of and intersect the body's flank;
- a flat, wide, pancake-like rim/skirt layer runs along the lower edge of the body and wraps round the nose;
- hardware hangs underneath.

Edit the previous sheet (Image 1). Change only the hull's FORM BUILD (spine, deck layers, the climb, the back):
- Merge the many small slabs into a FEW BIG SLOPING forms: long continuous sloping surfaces from the low head up to the high back, in 3–5 big lobes divided by long seams.
- Build it from INTERSECTING shapes: big flattened pancake/lens-like discs and layers that cut into each other (including a wide flat rim/skirt along the lower edge wrapping the nose), plus a few big HEMISPHERE-like domes intersecting the body (e.g. on the flanks and the back).
- Firm hard surfaces; not puffy, not quilted, not stacked planks.
- Keep the insect profile (low head, steep climb, high fat back) and the overall outline of Image 1.
- Keep the part colours: spine orange, decks yellow (the big lobes, pancake layers and domes are DECKS unless they are the spine).

KEEP: overall outline and insect profile; the rounded-cube glass bubble hanging under the front with two cream pillars across its front face; forward thruster sockets in the front view; magenta recessed manoeuvring thrusters; engine block recessed inside the hull with four recessed rear nozzles; teal underslung modules; red hatch; side, front, rear and top views with view names, one baseline, same scale; three-quarter view; black silhouette; 1.8 m figure; "LENGTH 18 m", "BUBBLE 2.6 m" across the bubble in the front view, and part callouts; part colours and nine-entry legend; flat fills, dark outlines, plain off-white; no numbers, insignia, flames, exhaust, scene or shadows. Take nothing from Image 2 except how its forms are built and intersect (no paint, numerals, panel detail, windows, aerials, exhaust). Nothing smaller than 30 cm.

Tolerance: apart from the form build, unchanged to the eye.

artifacts.what: Round 03 concept sheet, copied unmodified from the built-in image tool.

decisions: Round 03's few large intersecting forms supersede Round 02's many stacked plates.
Interpreted outline preservation as retaining the overall insect envelope while permitting local dome protrusions.
Counted three primary yellow lobes visually, excluding the orange spine, lower rim and intersecting domes.

invariants: Low head, steep climb, high fat back.
Few broad sloping lobes, intersecting lens layers, nose-wrapping lower rim and hemisphere-like domes.
Part colours, nine-entry legend, four named views, cockpit pillars and recessed hardware.
BUBBLE 2.6 m label and underside magenta sockets.
accepted_decisions: Selected the first Round 03 output after visual inspection.
rejected_approaches: Inflated tube-like rolls and numerous small stacked slabs conflict with Max's feedback.
checkpoint.next_action: Max reviews the large intersecting hull forms.
